evidence: Labeled 'Validation', but modifies libbitcoinkernel C API functions (btck_block_check and btck_chainstate_manager_process_block) to run on shallow block copies.
rationale: The validation category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API. The changes modify libbitcoinkernel entry points to avoid reusing cached validation flags on btck_Block objects rather than altering validation logic or chainstate invariants in bitcoind.
